mapper.select: SELECT ci.id, ci.sku_id, ci.quantity, ci.checked, p.name AS product_name, p.cover_url, s.weight, s.grind_type, s.price FROM cart_item ci JOIN coffee_sku s ON ci.sku_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 JOIN coffee_product p ON s.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE ci.cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY ci.create_time DESC
